judgment_refs.phrase: must stop before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection where the sign or pavement marking indicates where the stop must be made, or in the absence of any such crosswalk, sign or marking, then before entering the intersection
judgment_refs.note: Compare original surveyed crosswalk/sign/marking hierarchy with full-body halt and crossing frames; no authored numeric legal cutoff.

judgment_refs.phrase: must remain stopped or standing until the green signal is shown
judgment_refs.note: Compare original governing-head color, stopped body intervals and first departure; preserve cited turn and paragraph (d) exceptions for separate review.

sweep_specs.rationale: The two exact straight-travel cases exercise requested halt and continue control while original signal-head, stop-reference, body and pixel observations remain pending.
missing_inputs: original Native signal-head facing and stop-reference survey
original synchronized four-view source pixels and 480-frame body trace

cases.rationale: Source-observed steady red full halt and green-release contrast at a surveyed stop reference; physical and legal outcome require original review.

probe.target_value_or_branch: full halt before sourced applicable stop reference and remain stopped while red until observed green

Whether a departure while red falls within any applicable exception
